title: Event
description: An event associated with DOGE staff doing something

id.$comment: These are generated by the sort_events processing script if they don't already exist in the file

date.description: A date in format YYYY-MM-DD but following the Extended Date Time Format (https://www.loc.gov/standards/datetime/) which supports notation for approximations

time.description: An optional time value in the form HH:MM (24-hour format)

event.description: A description of the DOGE-related event

fuzz.description: This field is used to explain if the event has some fuzziness associated it and why

comment.description: For making any comments about the event notes

agency.description: Can be a single agency or an array of agencies affected/involved in the event

named.description: A list of DOGE staff named with the event

items.description: The names of DOGE staff in the incident.

linked.description: A list of DOGE staff not directly named but linked with the event

items.description: The names of DOGE staff in the incident.

interagency_doge_reps.description: A list of DOGE staff representing different agencies at interagency meetings

named_aliases.description: A list of aliased names associated with the event (common in redacted court filings / FOIAs)

mapped_aliases.description: A mapping of aliases to name we have confidently identified

case_no.description: The relevant case_no for legal events

system.description: If the event is linked to certain systems, they will be listed here
system.$comment: The govt_systems/roles will be the definitive record for system access, but it can be useful to have events tracing it

items.$comment: Should I bring back an validator for system IDs?
